description: This file defines the ModelCondition interface used in the OFBiz widget model to evaluate conditions within a given context.

classes.name: ModelCondition
classes.description: An interface for defining evaluatable conditions within the widget model, supporting visitor pattern and evaluation methods.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this condition.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition in the provided context map.
